title: 第15章 暴打第16章 大武师
content_zh:
“辰儿，小心点。”
苏震山转过头来，叮嘱道。
“爹放心便是。”
苏辰咧嘴一笑，跳上战台，心中也是战意凛然。
从修炼《太上武神诀》开始，他还是第一次与人对战！
今日，也正好借苏青云之手，检验自己的实力。
苏青云不屑的看了苏辰一眼，讥讽道：“真不知道你这个废物怎么有胆量跟我约战，既然如此，那就让你见识见识我的实力！”
轰！
苏青云运转元力，八级武徒的气势也是彻底爆发出来。
“八级武徒！”
“这苏青云竟然又突破了，这样的话，他很有可能被选为武府成员啊？”
“真不愧是苏青云啊！
当年的家族第二天才，如今的第一天才！”
下方人群当中，传来了一阵赞叹之音。
苏辰不屑一笑：“看你这么张狂，还以为你已经修炼到什么地步，原来只有区区八级武徒。”
“哼！”
苏青云脸色一沉，冷哼一声，“就算只有八级武徒，但收拾现在的你也足够了！”
说罢，苏青云眼中寒芒一闪，踏前一步，准备出手。
正在这时，一股嘈杂的声音，却是从远处传来。
众人不禁是循声看了过去。

“林家家主林天雄到！”
“林家二长老到！”
“林家五长老到！”
“林家六长老到！”
一群人足有十几人，浩浩荡荡的走了过来，为首一人，赫然是林家家主林天雄。
此时，整个苏家之人都是不禁警惕起来。
林家，是天水城第一霸主，而苏家隐隐有成为第二霸主的趋势。
因此，苏家与林家的关系十分微妙。
如今林天雄亲自前来，显然引起了苏家众人的警惕。
“哈哈哈！
听说苏家两位小辈约战，我林天雄也想凑凑热闹，不知道苏家主可否欢迎？”
content_en:
"Chen'er, be careful."
Su Zhenshan turned around and warned.
"Dad, don't worry."
Su Chen grinned and jumped onto the fighting platform, with fighting spirit in his heart.
This is the first time he has fought against someone since he started practicing the "Tai Shang Martial God Technique"!
Today, I just happened to take advantage of Su Qingyun's hand to test my own strength.
Su Qingyun glanced at Su Chen with disdain and said sarcastically: "I don't know how a loser like you has the guts to challenge me for a fight. In that case, let me show you my strength!"
Boom!
Su Qingyun circulated his Yuan Power, and the momentum of an eighth-level warrior completely exploded.
"Eighth level warrior!"
"Su Qingyun has made another breakthrough. In this case, he is very likely to be selected as a member of the Martial Palace?"
"As expected of Su Qingyun!
The second genius in the family back then is now the number one genius! "
There was a burst of admiration from the crowd below.
Su Chen smiled disdainfully: "Looking at how arrogant you are, I thought you had already cultivated to such an extent. It turns out that you are only an eighth-level martial artist."
"Hmph!"
Su Qingyun's face darkened and he snorted coldly, "Even if you are only an eighth-level martial arts disciple, it is enough to deal with you now!"
After saying that, Su Qingyun's eyes flashed coldly, and he took a step forward, ready to take action.
At this moment, a noisy sound came from a distance.
Everyone couldn't help but follow the sound and look over.
"The head of the Lin family, Lin Tianxiong, has arrived!"
"The second elder of the Lin family has arrived!"
"The fifth elder of the Lin family has arrived!"
"The sixth elder of the Lin family has arrived!"
A group of more than a dozen people came over in a mighty manner. The leader was Lin Tianxiong, the head of the Lin family.
At this time, the entire Su family couldn't help but be on guard.
The Lin family is the number one overlord in Tianshui City, and the Su family has a slight tendency to become the second overlord.
Therefore, the relationship between the Su family and the Lin family is very delicate.
Now that Lin Tianxiong came in person, it obviously aroused the vigilance of everyone in the Su family.
"Hahaha!
I heard that the two juniors of the Su family have a fight, and I, Lin Tianxiong, also want to join in the fun. I wonder if the head of the Su family can welcome it? "
